National Petroleum Co Ltd posts steady annual growth amid stable production levels

CAIRO, June 18 – National Petroleum Co Ltd, a key player in Egypt’s oil and gas producers sector, reported steady annual growth on Tuesday, citing consistent production volumes and ongoing operational efficiency across its assets.

The Cairo-based company said net profit for the year ended March 31 rose 4.7% to 1.28 billion Egyptian pounds, up from 1.22 billion pounds the previous year. Revenue climbed 6.2% to 7.94 billion pounds, reflecting stable crude output and resilient domestic demand, according to a statement by the company.

“Our disciplined approach to cost management and investment in production technology has helped us deliver another year of solid performance,” said CEO Tarek El-Gendy. “We remain committed to supporting Egypt’s energy needs and maintaining our focus on operational excellence.”

Production averaged 31,500 barrels of oil equivalent per day, in line with last year’s levels. National Petroleum Co Ltd said it continued to benefit from stable market conditions and favorable pricing for local crude, despite a backdrop of fluctuating international oil prices.

Capital expenditure for the year was 1.05 billion pounds, with investments directed towards field maintenance, safety upgrades, and incremental development at its Western Desert concessions. The company reported no significant disruptions or unplanned outages during the period.

Industry analysts said the results reflect a period of relative stability for Egypt’s upstream sector. “National Petroleum’s performance underscores the resilience of local producers in adapting to market changes,” said Mohamed Salah, an analyst at Cairo Energy Research Group.

The Egyptian Petroleum Association welcomed the results, calling the company’s continued investment “an encouraging sign for the sector and for Egypt’s energy security.”

National Petroleum Co Ltd said it expects to maintain steady production in the coming year and will continue to evaluate new exploration opportunities within its existing license areas.
